scope: Observed proposals in frozen same-category view pairs in 12 HSSD houses; sensor depth and supplied camera poses. All source and query proposals considered; no labels or target poses used by matcher. Pairwise diagnosis, not a navigation success rate.
offtrack_protocol: Incidental sighting subgate. Each source proposal in turn is a reported owner, other localized source detections compete. A pursuit point is the first available detector anchor in a fixed hash-ordered third same-house/category view. No true object IDs select a viewpoint, detection or point. Different from autonomous operation; frozen HSSD box archive does not include confidence.
